firm_data.firm_description: Wolff, Goodrich & Goldman, LLP, is a Syracuse, New York-based law firm focused on all New York State workers' compensation matters. They represent self-insured employers, third-party administrators, and insurance carriers in New York State Workers' Compensation Law defense.
notable_facts: The firm has the most experienced workers' compensation practice attorneys in New York State.
They represent clients at all levels, including Administrative Law Judges, Board Panels, the Appellate Division, Third Department, and Civil Courts.
The firm claims to be the largest and most experienced law firm in the Syracuse District Office of the New York State Workers' Compensation Board.
